product_name: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE 5G Smartphone with Galaxy AI (JetBlack, 8GB RAM, 512GB Storage), 12MP Front Camera, ProVisual Engine, Long Battery Life
description: Slimmer, Lighter and Ready to Impress - At just 7.4mm thin and 190 grams light, Galaxy S25 FE is the thinnest and lightest FE yet. Now get more immersive viewing display with slimmest bezel to date along with a floating camera design for a sleek look. Now, it is easier to hold so you can get things done comfortably including hassle free payments through Samsung Wallet. AI for All - Enter the new era of Galaxy AI with a true AI companion that stays one-step ahead of your needs. Now you can perfect your shots with AI-powered Generative Edit of Photo Assist, remove background noise with Audio Eraser or edit smarter and faster with Auto Trim, seamlessly on the all-new One UI 8.0. And, the best part is you can keep your personal data safe with complete on-device protection powered by Knox vault. Best Camera with AI ProVisual Engine - Clear, vibrant and stunningly detailed selfies with 12MP front camera. And, with low noise mode reduce grain and enhance crisp details for sharp photos or videos-even in low-light conditions. Turbocharged Speed - Equipped with our flagship performance processor, hardware based ray-tracing and a 13% larger vapor chamber, now enjoy ultra-smooth gaming, faster responsiveness and more realistic life-like graphics. Reliable, All-day Battery - Galaxy S25 FE features a long-lasting 4900mAh battery, for all-day performance. It supports fast charging up to 45 W wired charger and wireless charging at up to 15W.
